mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compute_spec (id, name, display_name, gpu_brand, spec_type, pool_type, default_gpu_count, default_gpumem_mb, default_gpucores, default_cpu_cores, default_memory_gib, node_selector, tolerations, resource_quota_key, memory_gb, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{gpuBrand}, #{specType}, #{poolType}, #{defaultGpuCount}, #{defaultGpumemMb}, #{defaultGpucores}, #{defaultCpuCores}, #{defaultMemoryGib}, #{nodeSelector}, #{tolerations}, #{resourceQuotaKey}, #{memoryGb}, #{description}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE compute_spec SET display_name = #{displayName}, gpu_brand = #{gpuBrand}, spec_type = #{specType}, pool_type = #{poolType}, default_gpu_count = #{defaultGpuCount}, default_gpumem_mb = #{defaultGpumemMb}, default_gpucores = #{defaultGpucores}, default_cpu_cores = #{defaultCpuCores}, default_memory_gib = #{defaultMemoryGib}, node_selector = #{nodeSelector}, tolerations = #{tolerations}, resource_quota_key = #{resourceQuotaKey}, memory_gb = #{memoryGb}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM compute_spec ORDER BY spec_type, memory_gb DESC
SELECT * FROM compute_spec WHERE pool_type = #{poolType} ORDER BY memory_gb DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO resource_pool_spec (resource_pool_id, spec_id) KEY(resource_pool_id, spec_id) VALUES (#{resourcePoolId}, #{specId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM resource_pool_spec WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId} AND spec_id = #{specId}
mapper.select: SELECT cs.* FROM compute_spec cs JOIN resource_pool_spec rps ON cs.id = rps.spec_id WHERE rps.resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId} ORDER BY cs.spec_type, cs.memory_gb DESC
SELECT spec_id FROM resource_pool_spec WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId}
